blocks.text: prefer va would rather: tanlov va afzallik

Ikki narsadan birini tanlash haqida gapirishning uchta asosiy usuli bor: **prefer** (umuman afzal ko'rmoq), **would prefer** (shu safar, aniq vaziyatda afzal ko'rardim) va **would rather** (yaxshisi ..., ... dan ko'ra ... ni afzal ko'raman). O'zbekchada bularga «afzal ko'raman», «... dan ko'ra ... ni ma'qul ko'raman», «yaxshisi ...», «-sam yaxshi bo'lardi» to'g'ri keladi. prefer + -ing / to qizil kitobda qisqa uchragan (→ qizil kitob, 52-dars), like va would like farqi — 58-darsda (→ 58-dars). Bu darsning asosiy tuzoqlari: **to** yoki **than**, would rather dan keyin to yo'qligi va **would rather you did** dagi o'tgan zamon shakli.

**prefer** — doimiy, umumiy did: I **prefer walking** / I **prefer to walk**. Ikki narsa solishtirilsa, uchta qolip bor. (1) Ot bilan — **prefer A to B**: I **prefer** tea **to** coffee. (2) -ing bilan — **prefer doing A to doing B**: I **prefer** walking **to** driving. (3) to bilan — **prefer to do A rather than (do) B**: I **prefer to walk rather than drive**. Uchinchi qolipda **to** emas, **rather than** keladi, chunki ikki marta to qo'yish chalkash bo'lardi. Hech qachon **than** yolg'iz kelmaydi: «I prefer tea than coffee» — xato. O'zbekchada hamma qolip bir xil: «B **dan ko'ra** A ni afzal ko'raman».

rows: Mashina haydashdan ko'ra piyoda yurishni afzal ko'raman.
I **prefer to walk rather than** drive.

items.text: I **prefer** trains **to** planes — you can see the country as you travel.
items.translation: **Samolyotdan ko'ra poyezdni afzal ko'raman** — yo'l-yo'lakay mamlakatni ko'rasan.

items.text: She **prefers walking** to work **to** taking the bus.
items.translation: U **avtobusga o'tirgandan ko'ra ishga piyoda borishni afzal ko'radi**.

items.text: We **prefer to eat** early **rather than** wait until nine.
items.translation: **Soat to'qqizgacha kutgandan ko'ra erta ovqatlanishni afzal ko'ramiz**.

blocks.text: **would prefer** (I**'d prefer**) — hozirgi yoki aniq bir vaziyatdagi tanlov; undan keyin odatda **to**: I**'d prefer to stay** in tonight — «Bugun kechqurun uyda qolishni afzal ko'rardim». Taklifga javob sifatida ot ham keladi: Would you like tea? — I**'d prefer** water. Inkori — **would prefer not to**. Boshqa odam haqida — **would prefer somebody to do**: I**'d prefer you to call** first (→ 55-dars). would prefer bilan -ing kam ishlatiladi — to tabiiyroq.

**would rather** (I**'d rather**) ma'nosi **would prefer to** bilan bir xil, lekin undan keyin fe'l **to siz** keladi: I**'d rather stay** at home = I**'d prefer to stay** at home. Solishtirish uchun **than**: I**'d rather walk than wait** for the bus. Inkor — **would rather not** (to siz): I**'d rather not talk** about it — «Bu haqda gapirmay qo'ya qolay». So'roq: **Would** you **rather** go out **or** stay in? O'zbekchada would rather ko'pincha «**yaxshisi** ...» bilan juda tabiiy beriladi: I'd rather walk — «Yaxshisi, piyoda boraman».

items.text: I'd **rather take** the stairs — the lift is always broken.
items.translation: **Yaxshisi, zinadan chiqaman** — lift doim buzuq bo'ladi.

items.text: Would you **rather watch** a film **or** go for a walk?
items.translation: **Film ko'rishni afzal ko'rasizmi** yoki sayr qilishnimi?

items.text: He'd **rather lose** his job **than** lie to a customer.
items.translation: U **mijozga yolg'on gapirgandan ko'ra ishini yo'qotishni afzal ko'radi**.

blocks.text: would rather somebody did: o'tgan shakl — hozirgi ma'no

Agar afzallik **boshqa odamning** harakati haqida bo'lsa, would rather dan keyin to'liq gap keladi va fe'l **o'tgan zamon shaklida** turadi, garchi ma'no hozirgi yoki kelasi bo'lsa ham: I**'d rather you stayed** here — «Shu yerda qolganingiz yaxshiroq» (hozir / kelajakda). Bu — wish va if dagi kabi «xayoliy» o'tgan shakl (→ 39-dars, 41-dars). Inkor: I**'d rather you didn't** — juda muloyim rad javobi: Do you mind if I smoke? — I'd rather you didn't. «I'd rather you stay» — Britaniya ingliz tilida xato. O'tmish haqida — Past Perfect: I'd rather you **had told** me — «Menga aytganingda yaxshi bo'lardi». O'zbekchada: «-sangiz yaxshi bo'lardi», «-masangiz yaxshi edi».

items.text: I'd **rather you came** on Monday — I'm busy at the weekend.
items.translation: **Dushanba kuni kelganingiz yaxshiroq** — dam olish kunlari bandman.

items.text: Do you mind if I open the window? — I'd **rather you didn't**.
My mother **would rather I lived** closer to home.

blocks.text: **I'd** ikki xil o'qiladi: I'd rather = I **would** rather; I'd better = I **had** better (→ 35-dars). Ikkalasidan keyin ham to siz fe'l keladi, lekin ma'no farqli: I'd rather **go** — «Yaxshisi, boraman» (afzallik); I'd better **go** — «Borganim ma'qul, bo'lmasa yomon bo'ladi» (maslahat, ogohlantirish).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I prefer tea than coffee.» → I **prefer** tea **to** coffee.; «I prefer to walk than drive.» → I prefer to walk **rather than** drive.; «I'd rather to stay at home.» → I**'d rather stay** at home.; «I'd rather not to go.» → I**'d rather not go**.; «I'd rather you stay here.» → I**'d rather you stayed** here.; «I'd rather walk to wait for the bus.» → I'd rather walk **than** wait for the bus.; «I'd prefer staying in tonight» (aniq vaziyat) → I**'d prefer to stay** in tonight.

Eslab qolish: **prefer ... to**, **rather ... than** — rather va than ikkalasi ham «th» bilan yoziladi va doim juft yuradi; prefer esa **to** bilan juftlashadi. would rather — **to siz**, would prefer — **to bilan**. Boshqa odam haqida: would rather + **o'tgan shakl** (you went, he didn't), would prefer + **kishi + to** (you to go).

rows: U itdan ko'ra mushukni afzal ko'radi.
I **prefer to wait rather than** pay more.
Ko'proq to'lagandan ko'ra kutishni afzal ko'raman.
I**'d rather you didn't** tell her.

examples.title: **prefer** + -ing / **to**: general preferences
examples.description: Umumiy, doimiy afzallik: prefer + -ing yoki prefer + to — ma'no deyarli bir xil. Inkor — prefer not to.

sentences.text: I **prefer working** in the morning, when my head is clear.
sentences.translation: Kallam tiniq bo'lgan ertalab **ishlashni afzal ko'raman**.

sentences.text: Most of my friends **prefer to live** in the city centre, close to their offices.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarimning ko'pchiligi ishxonasiga yaqin, shahar markazida **yashashni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Does Bekzod **prefer travelling** alone or with a group? — Alone, definitely.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **yolg'iz sayohat qilishni afzal ko'radimi** yoki guruh bilanmi? — Albatta, yolg'iz.

sentences.text: Many older people **prefer paying** in cash rather than using a card.
sentences.translation: Ko'p keksalar karta ishlatgandan ko'ra **naqd pul to'lashni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: My sister **prefers to study** at the library because our flat is too noisy.
sentences.translation: Uyimiz juda shovqinli bo'lgani uchun singlim kutubxonada **o'qishni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Why do you **prefer shopping** online? — It saves time, and there's more choice.
sentences.translation: Nega **onlayn xarid qilishni afzal ko'rasiz**? — Vaqt tejaydi, tanlov ham ko'proq.

sentences.text: Kate **prefers not to talk** about her private life at work.
sentences.translation: Keyt ishda shaxsiy hayoti haqida **gapirmaslikni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Customers increasingly **prefer to book** their holidays through apps.
sentences.translation: Mijozlar ta'tilini ilovalar orqali **bron qilishni** tobora ko'proq **afzal ko'rmoqda**.

sentences.text: In summer, Jasur **prefers getting** up at five, before it gets too hot.
sentences.translation: Yozda Jasur havo qizib ketmasdan, soat beshda **turishni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Which do you **prefer** — **reading** the book or **watching** the film?
sentences.translation: Qaysi biri sizga ma'qulroq — kitobni **o'qishmi** yoki filmni **ko'rish**?

examples.title: **prefer** A **to** B / **rather than**
examples.description: Ikki narsani solishtirish: prefer A to B, prefer doing A to doing B, prefer to do A rather than (do) B. O'zbekchada «B dan ko'ra A ni».

sentences.text: I **prefer** tea **to** coffee, especially in the evening.
sentences.translation: Ayniqsa kechqurun, **qahvadan ko'ra choyni afzal ko'raman**.

sentences.text: Emma **prefers** the countryside **to** the city because she grew up on a farm.
sentences.translation: Fermada o'sgani uchun Emma **shahardan ko'ra qishloqni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **prefers** cycling **to** driving — it's faster in the rush hour.
sentences.translation: Aziz **mashina haydashdan ko'ra velosiped haydashni afzal ko'radi** — tig'iz soatlarda bu tezroq.

sentences.text: We **prefer to rent** a flat **rather than** stay in a hotel when we travel.
sentences.translation: Sayohat qilganda **mehmonxonada turgandan ko'ra kvartira ijaraga olishni afzal ko'ramiz**.

sentences.text: Do you **prefer** summer **to** winter, or do you like the cold?
sentences.translation: Siz **qishdan ko'ra yozni afzal ko'rasizmi** yoki sovuqni yoqtirasizmi?

sentences.text: Madina **prefers** writing emails **to** talking on the phone.
sentences.translation: Madina **telefonda gaplashgandan ko'ra elektron xat yozishni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Many students **prefer to work** part-time **rather than** borrow money from the bank.
sentences.translation: Ko'p talabalar **bankdan qarz olgandan ko'ra yarim stavkada ishlashni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **prefers** home-made bread **to** anything you can buy in a shop.
sentences.translation: Buvim **do'kondan olinadigan har qanday nondan ko'ra uyda yopilgan nonni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **prefers to deal** with problems face to face **rather than** by email.
sentences.translation: Oliver **muammolarni elektron pochta orqali emas, yuzma-yuz hal qilishni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Nowadays more people **prefer** streaming films at home **to** going to the cinema.
sentences.translation: Hozir ko'proq odamlar **kinoteatrga borgandan ko'ra filmlarni uyda onlayn ko'rishni afzal ko'radi**.

examples.title: **would prefer to**: in this situation
examples.description: Aniq vaziyatdagi tanlov: would prefer to (not to), would prefer + ot, would prefer somebody to do. O'zbekchada «afzal ko'rardim».

sentences.text: I'd **prefer to stay** in tonight — I'm too tired to go out.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **uyda qolishni afzal ko'rardim** — tashqariga chiqishga juda charchaganman.

sentences.text: Would you **prefer to sit** by the window or near the door?
sentences.translation: Deraza yonida **o'tirishni afzal ko'rasizmi** yoki eshik yonidami?

sentences.text: Sarah **would prefer not to travel** on Friday, because the trains are always full.
sentences.translation: Poyezdlar doim to'la bo'lgani uchun Sara juma kuni **yo'lga chiqmaslikni afzal ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: We'd **prefer to have** the meeting in the afternoon, if that's possible.
sentences.translation: Iloji bo'lsa, yig'ilishni tushdan keyin **o'tkazishni afzal ko'rardik**.

sentences.text: Would you like some tea? — Actually, I'd **prefer** a glass of water, thanks.
sentences.translation: Choy ichasizmi? — Aslida, bir stakan **suv afzalroq**, rahmat.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **would prefer to take** the train **rather than** fly to Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Buxoroga **samolyotda uchgandan ko'ra poyezdda borishni afzal ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: I'd **prefer you to call** me before you come round.
sentences.translation: Kelishingdan oldin menga **qo'ng'iroq qilishingni afzal ko'rardim**.

sentences.text: The manager **would prefer us to finish** the report by Thursday.
sentences.translation: Menejer hisobotni payshanbagacha **tugatishimizni afzal ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: Which film **would** you **prefer to see** — the comedy or the thriller?
sentences.translation: Qaysi filmni **ko'rishni afzal ko'rasiz** — komediyanimi yoki trillernimi?

sentences.text: Bekzod **would prefer to wait** until prices go down before buying a new phone.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi telefon olishdan oldin narxlar tushishini **kutishni afzal ko'rardi**.

examples.title: **would rather** (do) ... **than** ...
examples.description: would rather + to siz fe'l; solishtirish — than; inkor — would rather not. O'zbekchada «yaxshisi ...», «... dan ko'ra ... ni afzal ko'raman».

sentences.text: I'd **rather walk** — it's only ten minutes, and it's a lovely evening.
sentences.translation: **Yaxshisi, piyoda boraman** — atigi o'n daqiqalik yo'l, kech ham juda yoqimli.

sentences.text: Shall we take a taxi? — I'd **rather not**, they're so expensive here.
sentences.translation: Taksiga o'tiramizmi? — **Yaxshisi, yo'q**, bu yerda juda qimmat.

sentences.text: Jasur **would rather work** late tonight **than** come in on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Jasur **shanba kuni kelgandan ko'ra bugun kechgacha ishlashni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Would you **rather go** to the mountains **or** to the seaside this summer?
sentences.translation: Bu yoz **tog'ga borishni afzal ko'rasizmi** yoki dengizgami?

sentences.text: Honestly, I'd **rather stay** single **than** marry someone I don't love.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, sevmagan odamimga turmushga chiqqandan ko'ra **yolg'iz qolganim yaxshi**.

sentences.text: My kids **would rather play** video games **than** do their homework.
sentences.translation: Bolalarim **uy vazifasini qilgandan ko'ra video o'yin o'ynashni afzal ko'rishadi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **would rather not talk** about the accident — it still upsets her.
sentences.translation: Nilufar baxtsiz hodisa haqida **gapirmaslikni afzal ko'radi** — u hali ham xafa bo'ladi.

sentences.text: We'd **rather pay** a bit more **than** stay in a hotel far from the centre.
sentences.translation: Markazdan uzoqdagi mehmonxonada turgandan ko'ra **biroz ko'proq to'laganimiz yaxshi**.

sentences.text: Where **would** you **rather live**, Manchester or Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: Qayerda **yashashni afzal ko'rardingiz**, Manchesterdami yoki Edinburgdami?

sentences.text: To be honest, Tom **would rather lose** the game **than** cheat.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, Tom **aldagandan ko'ra yutqazishni afzal ko'radi**.

examples.title: **would prefer to** or **would rather**?
examples.description: Bir xil ma'no, ikki xil qolip: would prefer **to** do ... rather than, would rather do ... **than**. Ba'zi gaplarda ikkalasi yonma-yon.

sentences.text: Madina **would prefer to cook** at home **rather than** go out for dinner tonight.
sentences.translation: Madina bugun kechqurun **restoranga borgandan ko'ra uyda ovqat qilishni afzal ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: Her husband **would rather go** out **than** spend the evening in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Eri esa **kechni oshxonada o'tkazgandan ko'ra tashqariga chiqishni afzal ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: Would you **prefer to start** now, or **would** you **rather wait** for the others?
sentences.translation: Hozir **boshlashni afzal ko'rasizmi** yoki **boshqalarni kutganimiz ma'qulmi**?

sentences.text: I'd **prefer not to discuss** my salary in front of the whole team.
sentences.translation: Butun jamoa oldida maoshimni **muhokama qilmaslikni afzal ko'rardim**.

sentences.text: Kate **would rather not say** how old she is.
sentences.translation: Keyt necha yoshda ekanini **aytmaslikni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Most passengers **would prefer to pay** a little more **rather than** wait three hours.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik yo'lovchilar **uch soat kutgandan ko'ra biroz ko'proq to'lashni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Personally, I'd **rather spend** money on travel **than** on clothes.
sentences.translation: Shaxsan men **kiyimdan ko'ra sayohatga pul sarflashni afzal ko'raman**.

sentences.text: Would your parents **prefer** a hotel, or **would** they **rather stay** with us?
sentences.translation: Ota-onang **mehmonxonani afzal ko'rarmikan** yoki biznikida **qolgani ma'qulmi**?

sentences.text: Our team **would rather lose** a client **than** lower the quality of our work.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz **ish sifatini tushirgandan ko'ra mijozni yo'qotishni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Given the choice, Aziz **would prefer to work** from home three days a week.
sentences.translation: Tanlash imkoni bo'lsa, Aziz haftada uch kun **uydan ishlashni afzal ko'rardi**.

examples.title: **would rather** somebody **did**
examples.description: Boshqa odamning harakati haqida: would rather + kishi + o'tgan shakl (hozirgi ma'no). I'd rather you didn't — muloyim rad. O'tmish uchun — had done.

sentences.text: I'd **rather you didn't** smoke in the car, if you don't mind.
sentences.translation: Qarshi bo'lmasangiz, mashinada **chekmasangiz yaxshi bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Can I bring a friend to the party? — Actually, I'd **rather you didn't**. There's not much room.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga do'stimni olib kelsam bo'ladimi? — Aslida, **olib kelmasang yaxshi edi**. Joy kam.

sentences.text: My parents **would rather I studied** medicine, but I want to be a designer.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam **tibbiyotni o'qishimni afzal ko'rishardi**, lekin men dizayner bo'lmoqchiman.

sentences.text: Personally, I'd **rather we left** now — the traffic gets terrible after five.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, **hozir jo'nasak yaxshiroq** — beshdan keyin tirbandlik dahshatli bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Would you **rather I came** back later? — Yes, if you don't mind.
sentences.translation: **Keyinroq kelsam yaxshiroqmi**? — Ha, agar qarshi bo'lmasangiz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **would rather her children didn't** spend so much time on their phones.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **bolalari telefonda shuncha vaqt o'tkazmasligini istardi**.

sentences.text: The boss **would rather we kept** the news to ourselves until Monday.
sentences.translation: Boshliq yangilikni dushanbagacha **o'zimizda saqlashimizni afzal ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: Shall I tell Oliver? — No, **I'd rather you let** me tell him myself.
sentences.translation: Oliverga aytaymi? — Yo'q, **buni menga qo'yib bersang yaxshi bo'lardi**, unga o'zim aytaman.

sentences.text: Aziz **would rather his sister didn't drive** to Fergana alone at night.
sentences.translation: Aziz **singlisi kechasi Farg'onaga yolg'iz mashina haydab bormasligini istardi**.

sentences.text: I'd **rather you had told** me the truth from the beginning.
sentences.translation: **Boshidanoq menga haqiqatni aytganingda yaxshi bo'lardi**.

examples.title: Looking back: **would rather have done**
examples.description: O'tmishdagi tanlov haqida afsus: would rather have done (o'zim), would rather somebody had done (boshqasi). O'zbekchada «-ganimda yaxshi bo'lardi».

sentences.text: The film was awful — I **would rather have stayed** at home.
sentences.translation: Film dahshatli edi — **uyda qolganimda yaxshi bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Looking back, Sarah **would rather have studied** law than economics.
sentences.translation: Ortga nazar tashlab, Sara **iqtisoddan ko'ra huquqni o'qiganida yaxshi bo'lardi**, deb o'ylaydi.

sentences.text: My father **would rather I had asked** him before borrowing his car.
sentences.translation: Dadam mashinasini olishdan oldin **undan so'raganimni istagan edi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **would rather have taken** the train — the flight was delayed for five hours.
sentences.translation: Jasur **poyezdda ketganida yaxshi bo'lardi** — reys besh soatga kechikdi.

sentences.text: Honestly, we **would rather you hadn't invited** so many people.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, **shuncha odamni taklif qilmaganingizda yaxshi bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Kate **would rather not have known** the ending of the film before she saw it.
sentences.translation: Keyt film oxirini ko'rishdan oldin **bilmaganida yaxshi bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Most voters **would rather the government spent** more on hospitals.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik saylovchilar **hukumat shifoxonalarga ko'proq mablag' sarflashini afzal ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: Would you **rather have gone** to the beach instead of the museum?
sentences.translation: Muzey o'rniga **plyajga borishni afzal ko'rarmidingiz**?

sentences.text: Bekzod **would rather have been** told about the changes earlier.
sentences.translation: Bekzodga o'zgarishlar haqida **oldinroq aytishganida yaxshi bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: In hindsight, the organisers **would rather they had chosen** a bigger venue.
sentences.translation: Ortga qarab, tashkilotchilar **kattaroq joy tanlaganlarida yaxshi bo'lardi**, deb hisoblashadi.

examples.title: Dialogue: what shall we do tonight?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: kechki ovqatni tanlayotgan er-xotin suhbati — prefer ... to, would rather, would prefer to, would rather somebody did.

sentences.text: — Where shall we have dinner tonight? Do you **prefer** Italian **or** Uzbek food?
sentences.translation: — Bugun kechqurun qayerda ovqatlanamiz? **Italyan taomlarini afzal ko'rasanmi** yoki o'zbek taomlarinimi?

sentences.text: — To be honest, I **prefer** home cooking **to** restaurant food.
sentences.translation: — Rostini aytsam, **restoran taomidan ko'ra uyda pishirilgan ovqatni afzal ko'raman**.

sentences.text: — So you'**d rather stay** in and cook? That's fine with me.
sentences.translation: — Demak, **uyda qolib, ovqat qilishni afzal ko'rasanmi**? Men qarshi emasman.

sentences.text: — Actually, tonight I'**d rather not cook** — I've been working all day.
sentences.translation: — Aslida, bugun **ovqat qilmay qo'ya qolay** — kun bo'yi ishladim.

sentences.text: — Then **would** you **prefer to order** something and eat at home?
sentences.translation: — Unda biror narsa **buyurtma qilib, uyda yeyishni afzal ko'rasanmi**?

sentences.text: — Good idea. But **I'd rather you chose** — you always find the best places.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Lekin **o'zing tanlasang yaxshi bo'lardi** — doim eng yaxshi joylarni topasan.

sentences.text: — Fine. Would you **rather have** plov **or** manti this time?
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Bu safar **palov yeysanmi** yoki mantimi?

sentences.text: — Manti, please. And I **prefer** green tea **to** black, if they have it.
sentences.translation: — Manti, iltimos. Agar bo'lsa, **qora choydan ko'ra ko'k choyni afzal ko'raman**.

sentences.text: — No problem. Oh, and Madina called — she'**d rather we didn't** visit tomorrow.
sentences.translation: — Muammo yo'q. Aytgancha, Madina qo'ng'iroq qildi — ertaga **bormasligimizni afzal ko'rarkan**.

sentences.text: — That's a relief. Honestly, I'd **rather spend** Sunday sleeping **than** visiting anyone!
sentences.translation: — Yengil tortdim. Rostini aytsam, yakshanbani kimnidir ziyorat qilgandan ko'ra **uxlab o'tkazishni afzal ko'raman**!
